question.:question/problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}8p+2q &=3 \\ -7p-8q &=-7\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order $p,q$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}8 & 2 \\ -7 & -8\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}8 & 2 & 3 \\ -7 & -8 & -7\end{array}\right]
$$

generation.domains: six latent nonzero signed integers, magnitudes 1..9; eligible 2x3 answer roles and error-role assignments vary; reject duplicate banks

\left\{\begin{aligned}-8u-2v &=-7 \\ 7u-8v &=3\end{aligned}\right.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order $u,v$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
\begin{bmatrix}-8 & -2 \\ 7 & -8\end{bmatrix}
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}-8 & -2 & -7 \\ 7 & -8 & 3\end{array}\right]
$$
